manifest.name: dsh-arcaea-theme
manifest.description: An Arcaea theme for DeepSeek Harness Desktop and Web, with bundled artwork, fonts and angular surfaces.

bundle.text:
# Added to a DeepSeek Harness desktop or web profile when installed.
- insert:
    - id: arcaea-theme
      name: dsh-arcaea-theme

readme.text:
English | [简体中文](./README.zh-CN.md)

`dsh-arcaea-theme` is an Arcaea theme for **DeepSeek Harness Desktop and Web**. Version 0.7.1 adds locally supplied Arcaea song-selection backgrounds and UI artwork to the **Windows Desktop 0.2.1-rc.3** adaptation, with bundled fonts.

- A light song-selection background with architecture, floating fragments, arcs and butterflies.
- The dark song-selection background in the sidebar, with original title artwork on the New Session button.
- More visible artwork on the new-session screen and a stronger light veil behind conversation text.
- Angular composer and New Session surfaces, with unclipped menus, editor and caret.
- A pale mauve desktop titlebar and dark sidebar, preserving native drag regions, window controls, sidebar collapse and split panels.
- A bundled Exo variable display face and bundled Noto Sans CJK SC Light / Regular / Bold body faces, with system fallbacks.

While enabled, the plugin keeps its dedicated `arcaea-light` palette selected. Disable it to restore the underlying built-in theme preference. Desktop text font and size preferences remain effective; an empty text font preference uses the bundled faces, while code and terminal fonts stay independent. The plugin does not replace chat components, modify session data, or make network requests.

The raw `Fonts/` and `img/` collections are not packaged wholesale. Selected fonts are in `assets/fonts/`, and three selected Arcaea images are in `assets/arcaea/`. All runtime assets are embedded as data URLs in `dist/client.js`, requiring no external image or font services. Fonts include their SIL Open Font License 1.1 texts. Image source paths and placements are recorded in `assets/arcaea/README.md`; see `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md` for ownership details.

Build from the plugin directory:

```powershell
node scripts/build.mjs
```

Fully quit DeepSeek Harness, including its tray process. Use the CLI bundled with the desktop app and the `desktop` profile. Adjust these paths to your installation:

```powershell
$dshDesktopCli = 'D:\DSH\resources\runtime\cli\bin\dsh.cmd'
& $dshDesktopCli plugin --profile desktop add 'D:\zhuomian\dsh-plugin\dsh-arcaea-theme'
```

Restart Desktop. You can also pass a packaged `.tgz` instead of the source directory. Desktop uses the `web` client platform: the manifest's `dsh.client.platform: "web"` is intentional, while `desktop` is the installation profile.

To uninstall, fully quit Desktop, then run:

```powershell
& $dshDesktopCli plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-arcaea-theme
```

Use the Web CLI, then restart the server and hard-refresh your browser. Do not run `pnpm dsh` in the theme directory: it does not provide that executable.

```powershell
pnpm --dir D:\deepseek-harness dsh plugin --profile web add D:\zhuomian\dsh-plugin\dsh-arcaea-theme
pnpm --dir D:\deepseek-harness dsh web
```

```powershell
node scripts/build.mjs
node --test
npm pack --dry-run
```

Desktop regression runner: `scripts/inspect-desktop.mjs`. First install the theme into an isolated `DSH_HOME` using the bundled desktop CLI, then run:

```powershell
node scripts/inspect-desktop.mjs '<Playwright index.mjs>' 'D:\DSH\DeepSeek Harness.exe' '<isolated DSH_HOME>' '.local\desktop-check'
```

The runner checks bundled fonts, editing, four popup types, settings, sidebar collapse, the right panel and three window sizes in the actual desktop app. It saves screenshots and `report.json`, uses an isolated profile, and makes no model calls. Windows 0.2.1-rc.3 has been tested; macOS and Linux have not been tested on-device. Browser fixtures also cover the legacy Web layout.
Plugin code is MIT licensed. Arcaea artwork belongs to lowiro and the respective rights holders and is outside the MIT license. This is an unofficial theme and does not represent lowiro or Arcaea.

[English](./README.md) | 简体中文

`dsh-arcaea-theme` 是面向 DeepSeek Harness **桌面端与 Web UI** 的 Arcaea 主题。0.7.1 在 Windows 桌面端 **0.2.1-rc.3** 适配基础上，加入本地提供的 Arcaea 选曲背景与界面装饰素材，并内置所需字体。

- 主界面使用浅色选曲背景，保留建筑、悬浮碎片、弧线和蝴蝶细节；
- 侧栏使用深色选曲背景，新会话按钮使用原有标题装饰素材；
- 新会话页展示背景，进入聊天后自动加深浅色遮罩，保证正文可读；
- 输入框与新会话按钮保留斜切设计，装饰边缘不会裁剪菜单、编辑器和光标；
- 浅紫灰桌面标题栏、深色侧栏，保留窗口拖动、折叠、分栏与原生窗口按钮；
- 标题使用随包提供的 Exo 可变字体，正文使用随包提供的 Noto Sans CJK SC Light / Regular / Bold，并保留系统字体回退。

插件启用时固定使用专用 `arcaea-light` 配色；如需切回内置明暗主题，请禁用插件，届时恢复底层主题偏好。新版设置中的正文字体和字号仍然有效；留空字体时默认使用随包字体，代码与终端字体保持独立。插件不替换聊天组件、不修改会话数据，也不发起网络请求。

原始 `Fonts/` 与 `img/` 不会整目录打包。运行字体放在 `assets/fonts/`，本次选用的三张 Arcaea 图片放在 `assets/arcaea/`；构建时全部以内联 data URL 写入 `dist/client.js`，不依赖外部图床或字体服务。字体附带 SIL Open Font License 1.1，图片来源和使用位置见 `assets/arcaea/README.md`。第三方素材归属见 `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md`。

在插件目录构建：

```powershell
node scripts/build.mjs
```

先从托盘**完全退出 DeepSeek Harness**。使用桌面程序自带的 CLI，目标配置是 `desktop`。下面以桌面端安装在 `D:\DSH` 为例；其他位置请修改第一行：

```powershell
$dshDesktopCli = 'D:\DSH\resources\runtime\cli\bin\dsh.cmd'
& $dshDesktopCli plugin --profile desktop add 'D:\zhuomian\dsh-plugin\dsh-arcaea-theme'
```

重新启动桌面端即可。安装目录可替换为下载后解压的本插件目录，也可传入打包后的 `.tgz` 文件。桌面端使用 `web` 客户端插件入口，因此包内 `dsh.client.platform: "web"` 是正确的；`desktop` 指安装配置，不是客户端平台。

卸载（同样先完全退出桌面端）：

使用 Web CLI 安装到 `web` 配置，然后重启 Web 服务并强制刷新浏览器。不要在主题目录运行 `pnpm dsh`，该项目没有提供这个可执行命令：

```powershell
pnpm --dir D:\deepseek-harness dsh plugin --profile web add D:\zhuomian\dsh-plugin\dsh-arcaea-theme
pnpm --dir D:\deepseek-harness dsh web
```

```powershell
node scripts/build.mjs
node --test
npm pack --dry-run
```

桌面回归脚本：`scripts/inspect-desktop.mjs`。先使用桌面 CLI 将插件安装到独立的 `DSH_HOME` 测试目录，再执行：

```powershell
node scripts/inspect-desktop.mjs '<Playwright 的 index.mjs 路径>' 'D:\DSH\DeepSeek Harness.exe' '<隔离的 DSH_HOME>' '.local\desktop-check'
```

脚本检查实际桌面程序中的字体加载、输入编辑、四类菜单、设置页面、侧栏折叠、右侧面板和三种窗口尺寸，并输出截图与 `report.json`。测试只使用隔离配置，不调用模型。已实测 Windows 0.2.1-rc.3；macOS / Linux 尚未实机验证。旧 Web 布局另有浏览器预览测试。
插件代码采用 MIT 许可，Arcaea 图片属于 lowiro 及相应权利人，不属于 MIT 许可范围。本项目为非官方主题，不代表 lowiro 或 Arcaea。
